title: VPS at 3am (The Quiet Server)
style: industrial electronic dub-techno, 104 BPM, post-punk rhythm section, old school 808, live drum kit, syncopated snare ghost notes, chant hook, call and response, spoken-word intro, alt-rap cadence, bilingual English Spanish chorus
lyrics:
[Intro - dub-techno pulse, post-punk rhythm enters, spoken-word]
(spoken, calm, male)
three in the morning.
the server is quiet.
the server is awake.
the server is the only one who never asks why.

[Verse 1 - alt-rap cadence, bilingual flicks]
the quiet server in the quiet room
blinking green like a steady heartbeat through the gloom
i'm the only one up and the server's the only friend
that don't need a reason and don't need an end

running all the domains on a single quiet box
while the city outside is dreaming behind locks
and the cron jobs fire like a calm little drum
and the log files whisper, todo va a estar bien, hijo, come

[Pre-Chorus - 808 enters]
the quiet server, el servidor tranquilo
the quiet server, holding up the kilo
of everything i built when nobody was watching
holding up the work while the world was clock-watching

[Chorus - bilingual, chant]
VPS at three am
VPS at three am
the quiet server, el servidor
holding up everything we worked for
VPS at three am
VPS at three am
el servidor tranquilo, three am
holding the line, holding the man

[Verse 2 - alt-rap, slightly more groove]
the phone is off and the inbox is dead
the only thing alive is the green light overhead
and the soft little fan and the soft little hum
and the soft little knowledge that the work ain't done

but the work that's done is the work that holds
the server don't need to be told
the server just runs and the server just is
the quietest partner in the whole damn biz

[Pre-Chorus]
the quiet server, el servidor tranquilo
the quiet server, holding up the kilo
of everything i built when nobody was watching
holding up the work while the world was clock-watching

[Chorus]
VPS at three am
VPS at three am
the quiet server, el servidor
holding up everything we worked for
VPS at three am
VPS at three am
el servidor tranquilo, three am
holding the line, holding the man

[Bridge - dub-techno breakdown, spoken under, sub bass roll]
(spoken, low)
the loudest things in the day are the things that need attention.
the quietest things in the night are the things that just work.
i want to be a quiet thing that just works.
i want to be the server, not the alert.
i want to be the steady green light, not the blinking red.

[Final Chorus - biggest, full kit, 808 huge]
VPS at three am
VPS at three am
the quiet server, el servidor
holding up everything we worked for
VPS at three am
VPS at three am
el servidor tranquilo, three am
holding the line, holding the man
VPS at three am
holding the line, holding the man

[Outro - dub delay, 808 fades, spoken]
three in the morning.
the server is quiet.
the server is awake.
the server is the only one who never asks why.
be the server.
